## Immutability

`String` is immutable — every modification creates a new object. Use `StringBuilder` for loops that build text.

## Comparison

Use `.equals()` for value equality; `==` compares references. `.equalsIgnoreCase()` for case-insensitive checks.

## Text blocks

Triple-quoted `"""` blocks (Java 15+) preserve multi-line formatting. Use `String.format` or `formatted` for interpolation-like output.
